format: JSON Lines, one record per line

fields.question: natural-language question (BIRD for R-A/R-B; project-written for R-C)
fields.SQL: gold SQL (BIRD for R-A/R-B; project for R-C)
fields.cypher_okay: SQL and Cypher outputs matched under the corpus validation comparator (true for all 563)
fields.annotator: pseudonym A1..A5 for R-C records (real names withheld)

excluded_fields.reasoning_trace: LLM-generated SQL->Cypher derivation; not used by any result
excluded_fields.evidence: BIRD hint text / annotator notes; not used by S2/S3 scoring
excluded_fields.Author: annotator real names (personal data)
excluded_fields.question_id, Complexity, NLQ_2, NLQ_3, u: internal annotation/workflow metadata; not used by any result
